projects.title: Hunter License Studio
projects.summary: An interactive Hunter × Hunter-inspired license generator featuring customizable designs and holographic visual effects.
projects.description: A fan-made web application inspired by the Hunter License from Hunter × Hunter. Users can create personalized digital licenses with distinctive card designs, character-inspired details, and interactive visual effects. The project focuses on recreating the iconic license aesthetic through frontend development, CSS effects, and interactive UI elements.
projects.problem: Creating a convincing digital recreation of the Hunter License requires more than displaying static artwork. The challenge is to reproduce its distinctive visual identity, intricate details, and holographic appearance while keeping the experience interactive and responsive.
projects.solution: Built an interactive license studio that combines customizable card designs with layered visual styling and holographic effects to create a more immersive, personalized experience.
highlights: Multiple license designs with distinct visual identities
Holographic effects and interactive card presentation
features: Multiple card color and design variations
Detailed card styling inspired by the original anime
impact: Explores advanced CSS styling and layered visual effects
Demonstrates interactive frontend development beyond conventional CRUD interfaces
Combines fandom-inspired design with a functional web application

projects.title: Invoice Collection & Escalation Automation
projects.summary: Automated invoice follow-up and escalation workflow with AI-generated financial reporting.
projects.description: An end-to-end invoice follow-up system that categorizes outstanding invoices by aging thresholds and automatically escalates through multi-stage notification routing — from client email reminders to internal Slack alerts. Includes AI-generated executive financial summaries delivered as weekly Google Docs reports.

projects.title: Client Feedback Intelligence Automation
projects.summary: Automated multilingual customer feedback analysis with AI-powered reporting.
projects.description: An automated feedback analysis pipeline that consolidates weekly customer submissions, processes multilingual input (English, Tagalog, Taglish), and generates department-specific performance reports. Delivers color-coded HTML email dashboards with sentiment scores.

about.title: Systematic Approach. Measurable Results.
paragraphs: I'm an Information Technology graduate from **{educationInstitution}**, specializing in full-stack development and AI-powered workflow automation. My approach is backend-first — I focus on how data flows, how processes are structured, and how systems can be made more efficient before touching the interface.

Beyond web development, I design and implement automated business workflows using **n8n**, integrating AI models, APIs, and databases to eliminate repetitive manual work. I don't just build features — I build systems that scale.
